repos_data.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI LLMs to trade using MetaTrader platform
Interactive Brokers, curl-friendly, over REST + MCP. FastAPI + ib_async over a Linux-native IB Gateway: stocks/options/futures/forex/crypto/...
Dumb-as-rocks OHLC analyzer. POST your bars + the indicators you want, get back exactly what you asked for. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/ATR/VWAP/...
Runnable Python examples for MT4/MT5 trading via TradeMux — no MQL, no custom bridge.

repo_meta_data.description: MetaTrader 5 in a real Windows VM (Docker + QEMU/KVM), driven over REST + MCP: programmatic trading plus server-side TA. OHLC bars enriched with RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/VWAP/Ichimoku/Order Blocks/FVGs (primitives, not signals). Typed MCP tools mirror the whole surface. Multi-broker, multi-account. No Wine bullshit.
